meta.name: FORGE 77 optional compatibility layer
meta.note: Procedural browser-side equivalents plus pcall-wrapped CET bridges, and a CET-only IN-GAME PILOT that references vanilla Cyberpunk 2077 entity records by TweakDB id. No third-party or base-mod files are bundled, edited or redistributed. Detection never makes the prototype depend on another mod, and every game call is optional.

autodrive.note: Cyberpunk 2077 2.3 added vanilla Auto Drive (drive to a tracked map pin, V key). The community 'Auto drive' / 'Auto Drive Enhanced' mods by nobo (Nexus 14680 / 23157) and the 'Auto Drive CET hotkey for Wander' add-on (Nexus 19309) expose related behaviour. FORGE 77 ships its own procedural autopilot for the mech test, and an optional CET bridge that detects these mods via GetMod and hands off a waypoint when they expose a compatible function.
sources: Nexus 19309 — Auto Drive CET hotkey for Wander
autodrive.browserFallback: MF.compat.autodrive.steer() runs a deterministic steering/obstacle-avoidance solver in the procedural pilot test. It works with no mods installed.

crystalCoat.note: CrystalCoat is Cyberpunk 2077's native dynamic vehicle paint (2.2+): a Primary colour, a Secondary colour, a light hue and paint aspects such as metallic / glossy, opened by holding Y while seated. 'Crystal Coat Picker — Hex Codes and Color Library' (Nexus 35571) adds exact hex entry and one-line share codes. Mechs are not vehicles, so FORGE 77 implements a procedural Crystal-Coat-compatible parameter set on its generated mesh and reads/writes the same share-code format; the CET bridge optionally detects the picker mod and reports its status.
crystalCoat.browserFallback: MF.compat.crystalCoat shades every procedurally generated triangle from these fields (Lambert + metallic specular + flake + wear + emissive light bands). No textures, no assets.

pilot.note: Everything in the pilot test is generated at runtime from numbers: the mech mesh comes from MF.shapeParts() + MF.sigGeometry(), the terrain from a seeded value-noise heightfield, hostiles from other roster sig compositions, and the gait from procedural joint rotation. No meshes, rigs, textures or animations are loaded.
pilot.controls: WASD move · mouse look · LMB fire · Shift dash · Space jump jets · Q core burst · E shield · R missiles · V vent · T AUTODRIVE · C camera · P pause · 1–4 companion orders · Y Crystal Coat panel

disclaimer: Compatibility means: the prototype uses the same public concepts, key names and share-code format, and CET optionally detects the other mods with pcall-wrapped GetMod calls. It does NOT ship, patch, require or claim to control those mods. The CET-only IN-GAME PILOT spawns and moves vanilla game entities by reference, but it does not add custom meshes, rigs, animations, VO, vehicle seats or mount systems; those still need ArchiveXL/TweakXL/Codeware/redscript work and private base-mod APIs. Nothing here is verified inside the game from this repository. No base-mod files or ripped franchise assets are bundled.

ingamePilot.note: A CET-only attempt at a genuinely IN-GAME pilotable mech, with no shipped assets. It references entity records that already exist in Cyberpunk 2077 (the vanilla Militech Minotaur and Arasaka mech character records, plus drones / androids / spiderbots / turrets as signature parts). exEntitySpawner.SpawnRecord spawns them; WorldTransform + entEntity:SetWorldTransform move them each frame; registerInput + onUpdate read continuous controls; and Game.GetTeleportationFacility():Teleport locks V into a cockpit/chase/orbit transform. Every game call is pcall-wrapped and optional. If a record or API is missing the overlay reports it and drops to PHANTOM (cockpit-only) mode rather than breaking the game. No game files, meshes, rigs, textures, animations or base-mod files are bundled, edited or redistributed.
requirements: PC Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 / Phantom Liberty with Cyber Engine Tweaks (CET 1.38+ for patch 2.5)
A loaded save in the open world — not the main menu, not paused
CET Bindings: assign the MECHFALL IN-GAME PILOT keys under the CET overlay Bindings tab
No Redscript, TweakXL, ArchiveXL or Codeware needed for this CET-only path
sources: Nexus 34927 / 35346 and the Controllable Mechs project — Character.q003_militech_mech is the in-game Militech Minotaur

ingamePilot.disclaimer: This is a CET-only SCRIPTED pilot: it references vanilla game records by TweakDB id, moves existing entities and locks V to a cockpit / chase / orbit transform. It does NOT add a new custom mesh, skeleton, rig, animation set, VO, physics collider, vehicle seat or mount system. Spawned NPCs may use their normal game AI and can be hostile; deploy in a safe open-world area and press EMERGENCY UNDEPLOY (F7) to despawn everything. It cannot be verified inside the game from this repository. A production-grade in-game mech still needs custom .ent/.mesh/.rig/.anims resources, ArchiveXL/TweakXL/Codeware/redscript work and private base-mod APIs. No base-mod files or ripped franchise assets are bundled, edited or redistributed.
